Subject: POC Trial Planning - VerdantHealth

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed next steps for the POC/trial so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and ownership.

Call highlights (short):
- Goal: validate integration of Redwood inference for in-prod clinical note classification + routing.
- Key constraints: 95th pctl latency target <= 250ms for 512-token requests; sustained throughput target 50 QPS; cost target <$0.02 per request.
- Security: Verdant requires SOC2 evidence + network allowlist (staging).

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Functional: model outputs meet acceptance on our 3 evaluation prompt sets (baseline perf >= 85% on primary classification).
2) Performance: 95th pctl latency <= 250ms at 50 QPS for typical payloads.
3) Stability: no more than 1 incident impacting production-like traffic during trial window.
4) Ops: Redwood will provide baseline telemetry dashboards (latency, error rate, token usage).

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Trial length: 2 weeks (recommended): target start 2026-05-25, end 2026-06-08.
- Day 0: environment access + sample dataset upload.
- Daily: automated metrics + one async update in shared tracker.
- Weekly: sync call (Wed) to review metrics and any regressions.

Ownership (initial RACI draft):
- Sales (A): Marissa Cole — commercial owner, sign-off on success criteria.
- Trial Lead (R): Lauren Bishop — trial coordination, runbooks, SE support.
- Infra/Deployment (R): Aditya Rao — capacity planning, network setup.
- Security Liaison (C): Ethan Park — SOC2/Q&A, evidence handover.
- Verdant counterparts: see Sarah/Tom to confirm Verdant owners for app, infra, security, procurement.

Immediate next steps (Redwood):
- Share SOW draft (attached) and integration checklist.
- Provision staging endpoints and token for Verdant dev team.
- Aditya to propose capacity plan (number of nodes / estimate).

Can you confirm the success criteria above and provide the internal Verdant owners for App, Infra, Security, Procurement so we can finalize the RACI? Also attach any procurement timelines we should be aware of.

Attachments: redwood-poc-sow-draft.pdf (draft SOW), integration-checklist.csv (env checklist)

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
